stories.title: Peshawar ATC reissues arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi in Radio Pakistan attack case
stories.brief: An anti-terrorism court (ATC) in Peshawar on Wednesday reissued arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi, the suspended Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) Chief Minister in the May 9 attack case, while extending the interim bail of three former provincial ministers until November 17.

stories.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
stories.brief: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

stories.title: Centurions De Silva, Mendis foil Pakistan as Sri Lanka dig in
stories.brief: Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Mendis showed great staying power as both posted centuries to lift Sri Lanka to 404-4 on day three of the first Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi on Wednesday.

stories.title: Asian Development Bank approves $500m loan to help Pakistan strengthen disaster preparedness
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Wednesday approved contingent disaster financing (CDF) facilities up to $500 million for Pakistan to withstand disasters and facilitate disaster response.

stories.title: JI to continue protests nationwide as it demands end to petroleum levy
stories.brief: Background of JI protests JI’s campaign against the petroleum levy intensified in August, when the party organised demonstrations and sit-ins across the country against rising fuel prices, inflation and what it described as an additional tax burden on consumers.

stories.title: Hoax bomb alerts sent to schools in Italy, UK and Ireland in latest disruption
stories.brief: Schools across Italy were evacuated on ‌Wednesday after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings, the latest in a series of threats and cyberattacks around Europe against supermarkets, blood banks, air traffic and broadcasters.

stories.title: 10 policemen martyred, 18 terrorists killed in attack on Kohat police team
stories.brief: It added that the police personnel martyred in the attack belonged to Kohat district and their sacrifices would always be remembered. K-P Governor Faisal Karim Kundi strongly condemned the attack, expressing grief over the martyrdom of police personnel.

stories.title: ADB announces $500m in contingent disaster financing for Pakistan
stories.brief: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Wednesday approved $500 million in contingent disaster financing facilities for Pakistan to help the country withstand and respond to natural disasters, providing prompt budget support following eligible disaster events. The ADB has also supported Pakistan's climate and disaster resilience efforts through earlier financing.

stories.title: Imran's BP at 'frightening level' but ex-PM still 'alert and strong', Latif Khosa says after hours-long Adiala meeting
stories.brief: Today nearly Three (3) hours long meeting with Imran Khan Sb & Bushra Bibi was allowed by Adyala Jail Authorities. In April 2026, Barrister Salman Safdar met Imran for a 60-minute legal consultation on the IHC’s orders, but Bushra Bibi was not brought in to join the meeting.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz seeks concessional financing to achieve 35pc clean energy target by 2035
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Wednesday called on international partners to provide concessional financing and facilitate the transfer of affordable technology to help Pakistan achieve its target of increasing the share of clean energy to 35 per cent by 2035.

stories.title: Dhananjaya de Silva, Kusal Mendis blast centuries to put Sri Lanka in control
stories.brief: KARACHI: Dhananjaya de Silva and skipper Kusal Mendis blasted unbeaten centuries to put Sri Lanka in commanding position against Pakistan on the third day of their first Test at the Pindi Stadium in Rawalpindi on Wednesday.

stories.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
stories.brief: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine talks in UAE secure major prisoner exchange deal
stories.brief: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a major prisoner exchange following two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi

stories.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
stories.brief: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi end with prisoner exchange agreement
stories.brief: The talks in the UAE capital were the first ⁠between the two warring sides since February.

stories.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
stories.brief: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

stories.title: Christmas toy rush being driven by squishies and building sets
stories.brief: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

stories.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
stories.brief: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.

stories.title: Federal judge allows Trump’s $10bn defamation lawsuit against BBC to proceed
stories.brief: Trump-appointed judge Jeffrey T Kuntz partially denies British broadcaster’s motion to dismiss over editFederal judge Jeffrey T Kuntz ruled on Tuesday that Donald Trump’s lawsuit against the BBC can proceed, denying in part the British broadcaster’s motion to dismiss the case.
